package_name: M5 IAM Free — Local Starting Pod
license_state_notice: This package is a public-commons starter kit. Downloading, unpacking or running it does not create a TCID, a verified identity, a credential, an M5 Bank account, a licensed M5POD, or any authority. It creates a free, self-attested IAM starting pod on a computer the person controls.

activation_required.name: Register the human principal
activation_required.detail: Register an M5IAM account and establish TCID / M5HUM identity.

activation_required.name: Reserve and activate a private M5POD
activation_required.detail: Optional. A registered Bank of Me account and M5POD are separate from, and not required by, the free IAM starting pod.

works_before_activation: Open the IAM app with a double-click and attest to your humanity in one short form.
See what you have: your IAM, your chosen state chain, and your attestation in three matching parts (words, data, check).
Browse free and open tools you can use today, and the registered accounts you can open later.
Verify the hash-chained ledger and export the pod as one ZIP file.
requires_activation: A TCID, PayName, ENS name or WSW URI.
An M5 Bank account or a licensed M5POD.
Authority to sign, pay, transfer title or delegate to an agent.

runtime.interface: Local browser page served from 127.0.0.1 only; double-click launchers for macOS and Windows

non_claims: No TCID or other registry identifier is issued.
No account, credential, license or authority is created.
The ledger is an integrity check, not a signature.
